message: 3825 complete monsoon days, each integrated over 24 Kathmandu hours from 49 overlapping intervals
Kathmandu boundary weights independently verified: 0.25 + 47×0.5 + 0.25 = 24 hours; no UTC-day substitution
Each source uses its own 2001–2019 monsoon seasonal percentile reference (±15 calendar days); test years excluded
All 26 event totals cover onset-3 through onset-1; full-calendar rolling and matched source-specific training references used
31 days include non-permanent IMERG intervals; source status is retained in imerg_daily.csv
IMERG is a native 0.1-degree area-weighted bounding-box mean; ERA5 is the existing nine-point mean. IMERG is a separate satellite-derived estimate, not ground truth
